hook.say: If you are still just rereading your notes at eleven pm, you are honestly wasting so much time.

beats.say: You stare at pages you will never open again and then completely blank when the midterm hits.
Drop your slides or a photo of your handwriting into Kiln instead.
It turns your actual class stuff into flashcards and quizzes that actually feel like real test questions.
Drop tonight's lecture notes into Kiln and quiz yourself before bed.
